description: Confirm the baseline is green before changing anything. Install dependencies if needed, then run the full build, the unit tests, and cdk synth to establish that shared/backend/frontend/infra all pass on the current feat/mlb-postseason-site branch. This de-risks later features by proving the starting point is clean.
findings_detail: Baseline verified green on feat/mlb-postseason-site: npm run build exit 0 (shared->backend->frontend->infra); npm test exit 0 (shared 37, backend 111, frontend 194, infra 9 tests all pass); npm run synth exit 0 (template emitted, only nodejs20.x deprecation warnings - pre-existing, non-blocking). No source files modified.
steps: Ensure the Node toolchain is on PATH for every command: prefix with PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" (fallback /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin). Confirm with `which node npm`.
From repo root /projects/sandbox/kiro-mlb-postseason run `npm run build` and confirm shared -> backend -> frontend -> infra all compile.
Run `npm test` and record the passing baseline count.
Run `npm run synth` and confirm cdk synth succeeds offline (no AWS calls).
Do NOT run `npm run test:e2e` here (deferred to final verification). Do NOT commit anything in this feature; it is read-only verification.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` exits 0 across all four workspaces
`npm test` exits 0 with all suites passing
